cohort: Icteric neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Abo-Elreesh Child Hospital, Cairo University, from July 2020 to June 2021.
finding: Eosinophil count and percent were significantly increased following phototherapy in icteric neonates with hyperbilirubinemia.
followup_time: Duration of phototherapy (exact time not specified)
